description.en: Creates the character the player controls from a party member: the party entry number (0 is the first) gives the character and body the kit (0 keeps the member's own). The events delete the current one first; the ev_main helper ResetEvLowMdlForCharaPlayer does both and returns the new handle.
Kit number, e.g. 902, 950; 0 for the member's own.

true once created, false if there is no member at that entry.
null if the script system is not ready or fewer than 2 arguments are given.
